title: Crystal melt stored by Trade at Central Nexus carried to the station bid at Frontier Station (Outer Rim, a moving station) and sold there
note: 2026-11-23 06:07 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-078, block MERCURY and P5. Frontier Station's own station bid for crystal melt: 3,787 x 13 (view_market, 06:06 UTC); Central Nexus bids 54. 17 jumps to altais (scripts/map.py route); the stop at the moving station is sent where it stands now (mobile.py, queue ENT-255). The carrier withdraws 13, sells at 3,500 or better, stores the rest there. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship (F37).
